facts.fact: NIRA's press statement cites the Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019 as setting obligations on processing personal and biometric data, including purpose limitation, minimisation and security safeguards.

NIRA says the Registration of Persons Act (ROPA) provides the legal framework for collecting, storing and using personal data in the National Identification Register, including ID and passport issuance.

facts.fact: NIRA says it runs the National Identification Register holding citizens' personal and biometric data, from which IDs and passports are issued under strict quality assurance controls.

UGA.note: Security safeguards (encryption, intrusion detection, monitoring) are stated, but no certification, published audit or assurance level.
